title: PrivateBin
descript: PrivateBin is a self-hosted pastebin with zero-knowledge encryption: the browser encrypts the text before it is uploaded, so the server only stores ciphertext, and pastes can expire after a time or after a number of reads, with optional passwords and discussions. Storage is local files in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: PrivateBin 2.1.1 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Zero-knowledge encrypted pastes with expiry and discussions; storage in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Paste text and share the generated link; the decryption key stays in the link fragment, so the server never sees plaintext. Pastes and the configuration live in DockerAppData/privatebindocker/data. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

github.description: PrivateBin docker image based on Nginx, php-fpm & Alpine Linux stack

wrapper_note:
the image serves the app with nginx on port 80 (unusable as uid 1000). This
wrapper runs the built-in PHP web server on port 8080 and keeps the paste storage
on the mounted volume.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: serves the app with `php85 -S 0.0.0.0:8080` (nginx binds 80, unusable as uid 1000) and keeps `/srv/data` on the volume.

zh-cn.descript: PrivateBin 是自建的零知识加密粘贴板：浏览器先加密再上传，服务器只保存密文；粘贴可以按时限或阅读次数过期，支持可选密码与讨论。存储就是应用数据目录里的本地文件。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。粘贴文本后把生成的链接分享出去即可；解密密钥保存在链接的片段里，服务器看不到明文。粘贴内容与配置保存在 DockerAppData/privatebindocker/data。界面为纯 HTTP，暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 PrivateBin 2.1.1，以非 root 容器运行。零知识加密粘贴板，支持过期与讨论；存储保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: PrivateBin 是自建的零知識加密貼上板：瀏覽器先加密再上傳，伺服器只保存密文；貼上可以按時限或閱讀次數過期，支援可選密碼與討論。儲存就是應用資料目錄裡的本機檔案。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。貼上文字後把產生的連結分享出去即可；解密密鑰保存在連結的片段裡，伺服器看不到明文。貼上內容與設定保存在 DockerAppData/privatebindocker/data。介面為純 HTTP，公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 PrivateBin 2.1.1，以非 root 容器運行。零知識加密貼上板，支援過期與討論；儲存保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/srv/data` (mounted from `DockerAppData/privatebindocker/data`) holds the encrypted pastes and, if you create one, the local `conf.php`.
design_notes: **PHP built-in server.** nginx binds port 80, unusable as uid 1000; the wrapper uses the `php85` binary with `-S` on 8080.
**Zero-knowledge.** Encryption happens in the browser; the server only stores ciphertext.
limitations: - The built-in PHP server is single-threaded; fine for personal use.
- Default retention limits apply; adjust them in `conf.php`.
- The UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
